name: checkout
command: set -eu; git checkout --detach f4a0108f9f12168f06c087e3c9dc3dd7e9d52fa4; git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD; git switch -c reader-platform02-exercise

name: tools
command: set -eu; node --version; npm --version; git --version; /usr/bin/flock --version; cc --version; bash --version; tar --version

name: owner-inspection
command: set -eu; cat skills/nova/core/execution/run-decisions.ts; cat skills/nova/core/lifecycle/reducer.ts; cat skills/nova/core/lifecycle/recovery-state.ts; cat tests/verification/reliability/lifecycle.test.mts; cat tests/verification/reliability/decisions-and-snapshots.test.mts

name: baseline-identities
command: set -eu; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain; git ls-files docs/generated docs/site skills/common/plugin-runtime/sdk/src/generated | xargs sha256sum; git config user.name; git config user.email

name: install
command: set -eu; DEV_NPM_CACHE="$(mktemp -d /tmp/kubeclaw-dev-npm-cache.XXXXXX)"; printf "%s\n" "$DEV_NPM_CACHE"; test -d "$DEV_NPM_CACHE"; test -w "$DEV_NPM_CACHE"; npm config get omit; npm ci --include=dev --ignore-scripts --cache "$DEV_NPM_CACHE"; node -e 'for (const name of ["typescript", "json-schema-to-typescript"]) console.log(require.resolve(name))'

name: author-prerequisite
command: git config --get user.name; name_status=$?; git config --get user.email; email_status=$?; printf "user.name exit=%s; user.email exit=%s\n" "$name_status" "$email_status"; test "$name_status" -eq 0 && test "$email_status" -eq 0

name: cleanup-inspection
command: set -eu; git status --porcelain; git diff --exit-code; ps -eo pid,ppid,args; find /tmp/kubeclaw-dev-npm-cache.ALIDsC/_logs -maxdepth 1 -type f -print
